I wanted to talk about the advertising rule and how it was applied to me. I get that rules are important for keeping the community organized, but here are a few points to consider:
Advertising, when done responsibly, can actually help the community grow by bringing in fresh content and more engaged members.
Many servers have specific channels or guidelines for sharing projects instead of banning all advertising outright, which balances order and creativity.
Completely blocking members from sharing their work can discourage participation and limit the unique content people bring to the community.
Clear and fair rules about how to promote things help avoid confusion and unintended rule-breaking.
Community rules should be flexible enough to evolve, especially if sharing projects benefits the group without causing disruption.
